when_to_offer: only at a genuine unresolved player decision when the player has not already declared an action
duration_display: square-bracketed estimated in-world duration or narrow justified range

horizons.long: half a day to weeks or a deliberate campaign-scale wait

crisis_rule: Do not manufacture medium/long waiting options during immediate danger; only legal crisis-resolving actions qualify.
interrupt_rule: If a choice crosses a known scheduled obligation or hard interrupt, annotate that expected boundary.
information_rule: Choices may state predictable commitments and known tradeoffs, but may not promise success or reveal hidden facts.
menu_rule: Choices are nonbinding suggestions. Any legal free-form action remains allowed.
storage_rule: Never cache generated choice menus in scene state.
